$comment: THE single source of truth for the OTP Snatcher DMG layout. dmgbuild-settings.py READS this file, so edit values here only. Ported from LaunchpadX: dmgbuild is used rather than create-dmg because create-dmg's Finder AppleScript silently fails to set the background on macOS Tahoe, and dmgbuild writes the .DS_Store layout directly so it works headless in CI. Coordinates are icon CENTERS in POINTS, Y top-down. Keep imagePixels = windowPoints x 2 and the background PNG at exactly that size, or dmgbuild stretches the art. The .dmg is a Release asset, never committed. Not notarized (no paid Apple account), so first launch needs right-click then Open; the app is still signed with a stable identity, which is what preserves the Full Disk Access grant across updates. See docs/signing-and-tcc.md.
